methodology.statewide_quantiles: deterministic every-16th-record sample; counts and means remain exact
methodology.percentiles: rank of municipal/county signal value, not a good/bad score
methodology.tax_field: latest positive reported annual tax; 2026 current_year_tax is blank so last_year_tax is used without inferring a tax-change trend
methodology.sale_warning: recorded MOD-IV sale fields are not represented as verified arm's-length SR-1A sales
